title: Immunization Record Standard - Counted Dose Entries on a Course with a Dose Found Not to Count
content:
**Immunization Services record standard: the dose entries a rebuild of a course's valid doses still needed counts from, when a dose on the course is found not to count.**

### Standard

> The dose entries a rebuild counts from are chosen as follows. For a closed course with a dose Kestrel reported to the state registry, every dose entry on the course is counted. For an open course with a dose Kestrel reported, only the dose entries that carry a lot number are counted. For a course with no dose Kestrel reported, only the doses Kestrel reported are counted.

### Definitions

1. **Dose entry**: a dose-given entry on the course's history.
2. **Registry report**: an entry on the course's history showing that Kestrel reported one of its doses to the state immunization registry. Kestrel reported a dose of the course when the course carries at least 1 registry report; with 0 registry reports it reported none.
3. **Closed course**: a course that carries a closing date (completed or cancelled); a course without a closing date is open.
4. **Carries a lot number**: the dose entry records the vaccine lot number; an entry with the lot number blank does not carry one.

### Counting schedule

| Course | Registry reports on the course | Entries counted |
|---|---|---|
| Closed | 1 or more | Every dose entry on the course |
| Open | 1 or more | Only the dose entries that carry a lot number, that is the dose entries less those with no lot number |
| Closed or open | 0 | Only the doses Kestrel reported: as many as the course has registry reports, which is none |

### Illustration (hypothetical course)

A course carries 4 dose entries, one of them without a lot number, and 2 registry reports.

- If the course carries a closing date, 4 entries are counted.
- If it carries no closing date, 4 less the 1 entry without a lot number, so 3 entries are counted.

The same course with no registry report at all counts only the doses Kestrel reported, which is 0, whether or not it carries a closing date.

### Boundary on the report count (hypothetical)

An open course with exactly 1 registry report and 3 dose entries, all carrying lot numbers, counts 3 entries; the same open course with 0 registry reports counts 0.
